highlights: Full Go rewrite: a single self-contained binary with an embedded admin console and browser extension.
Zero external Go dependencies, including a built-in Chrome DevTools Protocol WebSocket client.
OpenAI-compatible chat, Responses, image generation/editing and asynchronous video APIs.
Multi-account browser isolation, account affinity, automatic failover and 15-minute keepalive.
Reference images support up to four ordered inputs with public-URL safety checks by default.
Asynchronous image tasks with idempotency keys, queue admission limits and restart recovery.
All user-facing text, prompts, documentation and tooling are in English.
